item.title: github: CodeQL 2.27.0 adds support for Linux ARM64
item.description:
CodeQL 2.27.0 is available on Linux ARM64. The release also adds a new Rust security query, expands framework coverage for Java/Kotlin and C#, and includes analysis accuracy improvements across multiple languages.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: CodeQL 2.26.2 adds Swift 6.3.3 and Kotlin 2.4.10 support
item.description:
CodeQL 2.26.2 has been released with support for Swift 6.3.3 and Kotlin 2.4.10. It is the static analysis engine used by GitHub code scanning.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: CodeQL 2.26.0 adds Kotlin 2.4.0 support and AI prompt injection detection
item.description:
CodeQL 2.26.0 adds support for Kotlin 2.4.0 and introduces detection for AI prompt injection issues in code scanning. The release updates the static analysis engine used by GitHub code scanning.

  • Source: GitHub
